name: hippus_horseman
description: a Hippus Horseman, a moustached steppe rider with a black beard in a pointed bronze helmet with a long orange plume, bronze-and-orange lamellar armour with an orange-and-cream tabard, a round bronze shield on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear angled up in his LEFT hand, riding a light bay horse with a dark mane and tail, a white blaze, orange tassels on the bridle and harness and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round bronze shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.3: swing: the rider whips forward and brings the spear over the top in an overhand stab, its steel point leading toward the lower-right; the horse plunges forward and down, its forelegs reaching toward the lower-right; both face the lower-right
